description: Find & replace panel for the spreadsheet. Owns the query/replacement text and search options locally and bubbles changes to the host, which performs the actual search/replace and reports the current match position back via / .

parameters.name: MatchCount
parameters.description: 1-based index of the currently highlighted match (0 when none).

parameters.name: MatchIndex
parameters.description: Initial search options used to seed the panel.

parameters.name: OnClose
parameters.description: Raised to replace every match; carries the replacement text.

parameters.name: OnFindNext
parameters.description: Raised whenever the query or any option changes; carries the full current options.

parameters.name: OnFindPrevious
parameters.description: Raised to move to the next match.

parameters.name: OnReplaceAllRequested
parameters.description: Raised to replace the current match; carries the replacement text.

parameters.name: OnReplaceRequested
parameters.description: Raised to move to the previous match.

parameters.name: OnSearchRequested
parameters.description: Total number of matches for the current query.
